summary: Build climate risk scorecards, green credit lines, and portfolio dashboards. Enrol in practical climate and green finance credit risk training.
lede: Climate and green finance credit risk management assesses how physical hazards and transition pressures can affect borrower cash flow and repayment. For credit analysts, risk managers and product teams, the course provides a structured approach to climate-sensitive lending decisions. You will practice scoring borrower climate risk, designing green credit controls, and monitoring portfolio exposure with scenario concepts and indicators.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who make, support, govern, or report climate-sensitive lending decisions across banking and inclusive finance. It suits beginner-to-intermediate practitioners who understand lending fundamentals and need a structured operating approach for green portfolios.
modules: IFC Performance Standards and ESG Controls
prerequisites: You should have working knowledge of lending products, credit analysis, portfolio monitoring, or ESG risk processes. No programming is required. Familiarity with spreadsheets is useful because exercises use Excel-style calculations, and optional Power BI activities support dashboard practice. Advanced climate scenario modelling and taxonomy interpretation are taught at operational application and conceptual awareness levels, not technical engineering depth. A laptop with spreadsheet software is recommended.
